an8.35:1.1: “Bhikkhus, there are these eight kinds of rebirth on account of giving.
an8.35:1.3: (1) “Here, someone gives a gift to an ascetic or a brahmin: food and drink; clothing and vehicles; garlands, scents, and unguents; bedding, dwellings, and lighting.
an8.35:1.4: Whatever he gives, he expects something in return.
an8.35:1.5: He sees affluent khattiyas, affluent brahmins, or affluent householders enjoying themselves furnished and endowed with the five objects of sensual pleasure.
an8.35:1.7: ‘Oh, with the breakup of the body, after death, may I be reborn in companionship with affluent khattiyas, affluent brahmins, or affluent householders!’
an8.35:1.8: He sets his mind on this, fixes his mind on this, and develops this state of mind.
an8.35:1.9: That aspiration of his, resolved on what is inferior, not developed higher, leads to rebirth there.
an8.35:1.10: With the breakup of the body, after death, he is reborn in companionship with affluent khattiyas, affluent brahmins, or affluent householders—
an8.35:1.11: and that is for one who is virtuous, I say, not for one who is immoral.
an8.35:1.12: The heart’s wish of one who is virtuous succeeds because of his purity.
an8.35:2.1: (2) “Someone else gives a gift to an ascetic or a brahmin: food and drink … and lighting.
an8.35:2.2: Whatever he gives, he expects something in return.
an8.35:2.4: ‘The devas ruled by the four great kings are long-lived, beautiful, and abound in happiness.’
an8.35:2.6: ‘Oh, with the breakup of the body, after death, may I be reborn in companionship with the devas ruled by the four great kings!’
an8.35:2.7: He sets his mind on this, fixes his mind on this, and develops this state of mind.
an8.35:2.8: That aspiration of his, resolved on what is inferior, not developed higher, leads to rebirth there.
an8.35:2.9: With the breakup of the body, after death, he is reborn in companionship with the devas ruled by the four great kings—
an8.35:2.10: and that is for one who is virtuous, I say, not for one who is immoral.
an8.35:2.11: The heart’s wish of one who is virtuous succeeds because of his purity.
an8.35:3.1: (3)–(7) “Someone else gives a gift to an ascetic or a brahmin: food and drink … and lighting.
an8.35:3.2: Whatever he gives, he expects something in return.
an8.35:3.7: the devas who delight in creation …
an8.35:3.8: the devas who control what is created by others are long-lived, beautiful, and abound in happiness.’
an8.35:3.10: ‘Oh, with the breakup of the body, after death, may I be reborn in companionship with the devas who control what is created by others!’
an8.35:3.11: He sets his mind on this, fixes his mind on this, and develops this state of mind.
an8.35:3.12: That aspiration of his, resolved on what is inferior, not developed higher, leads to rebirth there.
an8.35:3.13: With the breakup of the body, after death, he is reborn in companionship with the devas who control what is created by others—
an8.35:3.14: and that is for one who is virtuous, I say, not for one who is immoral.
an8.35:3.15: The heart’s wish of one who is virtuous succeeds because of his purity.
an8.35:4.1: (8) “Someone else gives a gift to an ascetic or a brahmin: food and drink … and lighting.
an8.35:4.2: Whatever he gives, he expects something in return.
an8.35:4.4: ‘The devas of Brahmā’s company are long-lived, beautiful, and abound in happiness.’
an8.35:4.6: ‘Oh, with the breakup of the body, after death, may I be reborn in companionship with the devas of Brahmā’s company!’
an8.35:4.7: He sets his mind on this, fixes his mind on this, and develops this state of mind.
an8.35:4.8: That aspiration of his, resolved on what is inferior, not developed higher, leads to rebirth there.
an8.35:4.9: With the breakup of the body, after death, he is reborn in companionship with the devas of Brahmā’s company—
an8.35:4.10: and that is for one who is virtuous, I say, not for one who is immoral;
an8.35:4.11: for one without lust, not for one with lust.
an8.35:4.12: The heart’s wish of one who is virtuous succeeds because of his purity.
an8.35:4.13: “These, bhikkhus, are the eight kinds of rebirth on account of giving.”
